title: Whitley Medium Nubuck Tote Bag
description_html:
Whitley Medium Nubuck Tote Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 24"W X 13.75"H X 8.75"D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 4.5"
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance.
  • Hardware: Silver-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
